facts.fact: The Vice President said at the launch that LHIMS was deployed in about 481 health facilities across all 16 regions, being all six teaching hospitals, 10 regional hospitals, 243 district hospitals, three psychiatric hospitals and 50 polyclinics, with deployment to over 1,000 health centres ongoing; the Health Minister said 21 million Ghanaians had their data captured in it.

Ghana News Agency reports that patient records in all teaching, regional and district hospitals have been digitised and those hospitals interconnected, so that a referred patient's electronic record is accessible at another hospital in any region without carrying a file; the report states no patient identifier.

The Vice President launched the National E-Health project in Accra on 31 October 2024, with LHIMS, piloted in the Central region from 2017 and in its second phase since 2019, deployed in about 481 hospitals and polyclinics and being deployed to over 1,000 health centres.
